text: This report recommends that the name Pura Vida Lane be approved to identify an existing public lane located south of Hallam Street extending between Delaware Avenue and Concord Avenue. This naming proposal complies with the City of Toronto Street Naming Policy which can be found at https://www.toronto.ca/city-government/planning-development/street-naming/
The Toronto and East York Community Council: 1. Approved the name “Pura Vida Lane” for an existing public lane located south of Hallam Street extending between Delaware Avenue and Concord Avenue.
